## IMPULSE 0.6.1

This maintenance release refreshes the application identity with a new launcher icon built around the same one-tap chain-reaction idea as the game itself.

### Highlights

- New neon chain-reaction launcher icon with a bright central impulse, connected reaction nodes, and cyan/violet propagation arcs.
- Proper Android Adaptive Icon implementation so launcher masks are applied by the operating system instead of being baked into the artwork.
- Android 13+ monochrome layer for themed launcher icons.
- Android version is now 0.6.1 with versionCode 8.

Gameplay, campaign progress, deterministic level seeds, scoring, stars, statistics, settings, permissions, and offline behavior are unchanged from 0.6.0.

Release artifacts are signed with the existing project release certificate and published with SHA-256 checksums and GitHub artifact attestations.
